prompt: Clicking Settings or Reports in the sidebar blanks the whole screen, top bar included, until the page appears. On slow connections it looks like the app crashed.

truth.summary: The only Suspense boundary for the lazy routes wraps all of <Routes> in App with fallback={null}. While a route chunk loads, React hides the whole tree, shell included, and shows nothing.

referenceAnswer.cause: The lazy routes suspend to the single root <Suspense fallback={null}>, which sits above AppShell, so the whole app is hidden and nothing is shown while the chunk loads.

decoyAnswers.cause: The settings page throws while loading.
RequireAuth re-checks the session on navigation.

referenceFix.replace:
import classNames from 'classnames'
import { Suspense } from 'react'

import { useGetConfigQuery } from '../api/service'
import { Spinner } from '../components/spinner'

genieEvidence.notes: react_suspense works on React 18: it reports the boundary at app.tsx:19 in state fallback (exact) and says blockers are unavailable before React 19. It does not say that the boundary is an ancestor of the shell or that its fallback is empty. A verify claim `suspense TopBar hidden max 0` fails while that fallback hides the shell and passes once the boundary sits inside AppShell, though `render TopBar max 0` passes either way; the probe adds a DOM visibility check.
